change: Reordered primary groups: Gluteus Maximus promoted to first primary (research confirms it is the target muscle per EMG/lunge literature), Quads remain as co-primary. Added Soleus to secondary Calves (research confirms calves including soleus assist in lunge push-off). Added Lower Back (Erector Spinae) as secondary stabilizer for the forward-lean sprinter position. Gluteus Medius secondary retained.

Removed incorrect primary 'Abductor'/'Abductor' entry. The exercise involves hip flexion (knee-to-chest), not hip abduction; the Abductor bucket maps to the tensor fasciae latae/hip abductors, not the iliopsoas. The hip flexor here is best represented by Quads->Rectus Femoris (which is a powerful hip flexor and has an allowed mapping). Abs retained as primary. Obliques retained as secondary. Quads->Rectus Femoris added as primary (hip flexion drive).

No changes. Biceps Brachii primary and Wrist Flexors secondary confirmed correct. Brachialis and brachioradialis are synergists but have no allowed bucket mapping in this system, so omitted per rules.

Demoted shoulders (Anterior Deltoids) and Triceps from primary to secondary. The hamstring curl is the defining movement and the primary driver; the punching motion is rhythmic/coordinative and not a resistance-loaded primary effort. Hamstrings are the sole primary. Glutes, Calves, shoulders, Triceps, and obliques retained as secondary stabilizers/assistors.

Added Lats (Latissimus Dorsi) as secondary — in downward dog the lats actively depress and stabilize the shoulder blades (well-documented in yoga anatomy literature). All other groups unchanged and confirmed correct by research.
